findings.problem: The two private lemmas end with the same nontrivial argument, written out twice. Both have an A-morphism ι : A ⟶ W whose composite with h lands in an affine open U. Both have ρ : A ⟶ B with IsIso ρ.appTop and a section τ of ρ. Both lift ι ≫ h through U.ι with IsOpenImmersion.lift, apply eq_comp_section_of_isIso_appTop to the lift, compose with U.ι and simp using lift_fac to get ι ≫ h = ρ ≫ τ ≫ ι ≫ h. Both then run the same four-step calc, which uses τ ≫ ι = e ≫ σ and ι ≫ π = ρ ≫ e to reach ι ≫ π ≫ σ ≫ h. In the fibre lemma, B = Spec κ(y) and e = fromSpecResidueField. In the neighbourhood lemma (lines 190–204), B = T and e = T.ι. Any fix to the lifting or rewriting step has to be made in two places. The proofs are long, so the common reasoning is hard to spot.
findings.proposed_change:
Add one private lemma before eq_on_fiber_of_subsingleton_image.

lemma eq_of_affine_range_of_section {A B W Y Z : Scheme.{u}} {ι : A ⟶ W} {ρ : A ⟶ B} {τ : B ⟶ A} {e : B ⟶ Y} {π : W ⟶ Y} {σ : Y ⟶ W} (h : W ⟶ Z) (U : Z.Opens) [IsAffine U] [IsIso ρ.appTop] (hτρ : τ ≫ ρ = 𝟙 B) (hτι : τ ≫ ι = e ≫ σ) (hιρ : ι ≫ π = ρ ≫ e) (hrange : Set.range (ι ≫ h) ⊆ Set.range U.ι) : ι ≫ h = ι ≫ π ≫ σ ≫ h

Proof sketch:
1. Set b := IsOpenImmersion.lift U.ι (ι ≫ h) hrange.
2. Apply eq_comp_section_of_isIso_appTop ρ τ hτρ b and compose with U.ι. This gives ι ≫ h = ρ ≫ τ ≫ ι ≫ h.
3. Rewrite with hτι, regroup, and rewrite with ← hιρ.

In the fibre lemma, call it with ρ := ρ, τ := τ, e := Y.fromSpecResidueField y, hτι := hτι, hιρ := π.fiber_fac y, and hrange. This replaces lines 111–125. In the neighbourhood lemma, call it with ι := v, ρ := πT, τ := σT, e := T.ι, hτι := hσTv, hιρ := (morphismRestrict_ι π T).symm (up to the existing `change`), and hhrange. This replaces lines 190–204.
findings.benefit: The affine-constancy plus section-rewriting argument is stated and proved once. Each private lemma then only builds its own B, τ and range proof, so its geometric content is easier to read. The calc and simpa blocks no longer need to be kept in sync.
